author: king process
description:
Top 8 Korean Artisans Who Create Sound, from Game Effects to Temple Bells

Hello, this is King Process.
In this video, we have brought together eight Korean artisans who create a wide range of sounds by hand.
From a Foley artist who creates sound effects to match movements in video games, to harmonicas exported around the world, traditional Korean drums, temple bells, daegeum flutes, wooden temple blocks, and kalimbas, this video shows how each unique sound is made.
The materials and production methods are different, but they all require the careful hands of skilled artisans who inspect and fine-tune every detail.
See how the sounds we often hear in everyday life are created through different materials and production processes.
Enjoy the video.
Thank you for watching. If you enjoyed it, please subscribe and like the video.
